values.note: First come; the fee is paid online on the day of arrival (or at a state park ranger station) before taking a site.

booking.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html (same-day advance online payment for individual campsites; 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site'; Hay Lake not among the campgrounds with reservable group sites) + facility cmp00047 (no reservation link), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Minnesota state forest individual campsite, taxes included. Paid online on the arrival date or at a state park ranger station; nothing is collected at the campground. DNR state forest fee page, read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('Starting in 2026 ... $17 per night ($22 for equestrian)'; 'Fees include taxes'; 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site'; 'Onsite staff cannot accept camping fee payments'), read 2026-11-11

note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground beside the Hay Lake public landing in Savanna State Forest, with a small swimming area and water access. Wooded sites; the DNR says some have views of the lake. A quieter alternative to nearby Savanna Portage State Park, which manages it. --Claude
summary: DNR facility cmp00047 read: 20 primitive sites, vault toilets, well water, swimming area, $17 tax-included paid online same day (stored fee note's 'paid at the campground' corrected). Not waterfront kept with a lakeview lead. Pin matches DNR point. Phone missing; website hyphen.
flags: WATERFRONT lead (not waterfront kept): DNR 'Campsites are wooded; some have views of the lake.' The campground point (46.949909,-93.206518) lies about 110 m from the Hay Lake shore in continuous mixed forest on autumn Esri and NAIP frames; no loop or site is resolvable under canopy and the DNR facility map PDF (cmp00047.pdf) returns 404, so no site can be named. Reviewer may consider lakeview on the DNR statement; on the evidence gate it stays down.

FEES note corrected: stored note said 'first come, first served, paid at the campground'; the DNR fee page says 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site' and fees are paid online the same day or at a state park ranger station.

PHONE missing: suggest 218-419-1500 (Savanna Portage State Park, the manager on the DNR facility record). Google Maps lists 218-426-3271 (4.6, 18 reviews), an older Savanna Portage number; the DNR record is newer.
Pin 46.95000,-93.20650 matches the DNR facility point; no move. No DNR alerts; season not stated by the DNR.
Note cleaned: dropped the site count, pad/ring/table, toilets, water and 'No hookups' (fields hold them).
